method: Exact stored-float32 triangle contact predicates, including coplanar overlaps and shared-vertex/edge exceptions. Mark the longest internal edge of every contacting or opposed triangle, then bisect conformingly through the same published transform. At most 16 steps, 5000 vertices and 10000 triangles. Select lexicographic best (root orientation alerts, all orientation alerts, unexpected contact pairs, maximum sampled gap). Stop after five consecutive rounds without a better candidate. Contact pair counts are not a penetration severity or anatomical accuracy measure.

limits: A passing old core can coexist with alerts in its newly added outer ring
Counts on different meshes and different spatial scopes are not anatomical accuracy estimates
Fixed-tissue synthetic subdivisions do not add acquired anatomical observations, activity or delays
Positive sampled Jacobians and normals do not certify entire interiors, volume, self-intersections or global injectivity
All previews overlap the unchanged cortex and may overlap one another; no unified mesh is applied
Outer source corners have recorded float32 rounding; shared interior vertex indices are identical
Unexpected contact tests refer only to exact stored local float32 triangles; neither global cortex nor GPU arithmetic or continuous curved surfaces are certified
A zero sampled orientation count is not sufficient to rule out triangle intersections
